playbookOutputs: CIPC registration certificate (CoR14.3) for the NPC
SARS income tax reference number issued via CIPC
Note on applying for SARS income tax exemption / PBO status
playbookCommonFailures: Fewer than three directors / incorporators supplied — an NPC needs at least three
All four proposed names rejected or contain special characters
Certified ID older than 3 months or missing for one director
Objectives too vague to qualify as a public benefit or communal purpose in the MOI
Registered address supplied is a PO Box

informationToProvide.label: Certified copies of the ID or passport for each member
informationToProvide.aiHint: One certified SA ID (Smart Card front and back or Green Book) or passport per director / incorporator, Commissioner of Oaths / SAPS stamp dated within 3 months, legible ID number and names. Count them — an NPC needs at least three.

informationToProvide.label: How many Directors
informationToProvide.helpText: Select how many directors to register (minimum 3 for an NPC, up to 5+).

informationToProvide.label: Director 1: Full Name
informationToProvide.helpText: Full legal name and surname of the first director.

informationToProvide.label: Director 2: Full Name
informationToProvide.helpText: Full legal name and surname of the second director.

informationToProvide.label: Director 3: Full Name
informationToProvide.helpText: Full legal name and surname of the third director (minimum 3 required for NPC).

informationToProvide.label: Director 4: Full Name
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: Is there a fourth director to register?
informationToProvide.helpText: Full legal name and surname of the fourth director.

informationToProvide.label: Director 5: Full Name
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: Is there a fifth director to register?
informationToProvide.helpText: Full legal name and surname of the fifth director.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of residential address for each director
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of residential address dated within 3 months per director (utility bill, rates/taxes, lease or bank statement) in the director's own name.

informationToProvide.label: Address to be captured for the NPC
informationToProvide.helpText: Physical street address in South Africa.

informationToProvide.label: Postal Address to be captured for the NPC
Brief description of the NPC's objectives and activities
informationToProvide.helpText: The public benefit or community purpose the NPC will pursue — this goes into the MOI.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect director details, names, addresses and objectives
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certified ID and proof of address for at least three directors, four names, NPC addresses, year-end and objectives received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain plainly that an NPC needs at least three directors and that its income and assets may not be distributed to members — it is for a public benefit or community objective. Ask for four names without special characters. Mention that SARS tax exemption (PBO) is a separate application after registration. Turnaround 1-3 working days; never promise faster.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify director documents and name availability
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads pass; at least three directors with ID and address; names screened
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Extract full names, ID numbers, dates of birth and addresses from the IDs and proofs. ⚠ verify: CIPC requires a minimum of three incorporators AND three directors for an NPC (s13/Schedule 1) — the same three people can be both. Run a CIPC name search on each proposed name.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft registration handoff sheet and MOI object clauses
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Handoff sheet with all CoR14.1 fields, the four names, directors/incorporators and the MOI object clauses drafted from the client's objectives
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Use the CIPC standard NPC MOI (CoR15.1C) unless the client needs a customised MOI (e.g. voting members) — then flag for Kevin. Write the objects clause from the client's description in plain terms and include the non-distribution and dissolution clauses required by Schedule 1, which SARS also needs for PBO approval. Year-end defaults to February.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Reserve name and register NPC on CIPC
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Name reserved and NPC registration submitted with directors, incorporators, addresses, MOI and certified IDs; tracking number saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CIPC e-Services (or BizPortal) > Register a company > Non-Profit Company. Reserve the four names in order (CoR9.1), then register with the approved name. Capture at least three incorporators and three directors, physical and postal address, year-end and upload certified IDs and the MOI. ⚠ verify current fees (name reservation ~R50, registration with standard MOI ~R125 / customised ~R475). Record the tracking number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC to issue the certificate
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3 and registered MOI downloadable; income tax number issued
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the tracking status before following up. If the name is rejected, ask the client for replacements and re-reserve.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver CoR14.3, MOI and tax number
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificate, MOI and SARS tax number posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain next steps: bank account, SARS eFiling registration and tax representative, and that tax exemption requires a separate PBO application to the SARS Tax Exemption Unit (offer the PBO Registration service) and DSD NPO registration if funders require it (offer NPO Registration).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
